claims.statement: Code constants (ZALO_BOT_API_BASE, ZALO_OA_API_BASE, ZALO_BOT_WEBHOOK_URL, EMBEDDING_DIM=3072, DIGEST_SECTION_CHARS=6000, DIGEST_SECTION_OVERLAP=400, DIGEST_MAX_SECTIONS=20, INGEST_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600) are module-level Python names in backend/app/core/config.py; changing them requires a code change and deploy.

Settings(BaseSettings) loads from .env (dev) or shell environment (prod) via pydantic_settings; get_settings() is @lru_cache'd. model_post_init guards: jwt_secret must not be the committed dev default when app_env != development, integration_settings_encryption_key must be set outside development, and cors_origins must not contain '*'.

DB connection budget: peak connections ≈ (# DB-touching processes) × (db_pool_size + db_max_overflow). With ~11 production processes at 10+10, peak is ~220; Postgres max_connections must be ≥250. db_pool_recycle (1800s) proactively refreshes connections; paired with pool_pre_ping it removes 'connection already closed' errors.

IntegrationSettingsService reads from the integration_settings DB table; secrets are AES-GCM encrypted with key = SHA-256(INTEGRATION_SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY), falling back to SHA-256(JWT_SECRET) only in development. Resolution order: admin-managed DB row → env/bootstrap fallback.

admin_view() returns only {configured, preview: '<first4>...<last4>'} for each secret. Admin updates encrypt, upsert, record audit (changed keys only), commit, evict local cache namespace, and bump namespace version.

Two Redis-backed semaphores throttle provider calls deployment-wide: llm_concurrency_limit (default 8) and embed_concurrency_limit (default 6). A turn that can't acquire within llm_acquire_timeout_seconds (1.5s) raises LLMThrottled → DEGRADATION_REPLY.
http_max_connections (20) and http_max_keepalive_connections (10) size the process-scoped httpx.AsyncClient pool. Conservative defaults for the 2-vCPU droplet.
kb_sync_cron (default '0 20 * * *' = 03:00 ICT) is the daily cron expression for external-source sync, validated at startup via python-crontab so a malformed env value fails fast.
